You will act as a trusted technical adviser, translate customer priorities into solution architectures and help customers modernise their networks and operations. The opportunity: Lead the technical sales engagement for a selected set of Tier 2 service provider customers, bringing together HPE Networking capabilities across routing, switching, security, automation, assurance and cloud operations. AI-native operations, assurance, automation and sustainability are increasingly important in customer strategies and tenders. Continuously develop your technical, industry and competitive knowledge, and share expertise with colleagues and customers. Demonstrable hands-on capability in service provider routing, with useful experience in one or more adjacent areas: data centre switching, network security, automation, network virtualisation, cloud networking or observability and assurance. Experience designing resilient, scalable and operationally supportable network solutions, and the ability to explain architecture choices and trade-offs clearly. Knowledge of network automation and programmability using technologies such as Python, Ansible, NETCONF, YANG, REST APIs, JSON and OpenConfig is desirable. Understanding of service provider security, DDoS protection, zero-trust principles or secure managed services is an advantage. Good awareness of service provider market trends and emerging use cases, including AI infrastructure, network-as-a-service, sustainability and operations automation. Knowledge of HPE Networking products and solutions is desirable. Strong experience with relevant competitive platforms is also valued. Ability to build and deliver demonstrations or proofs of concept that showcase routing, switching, assurance and automation capabilities. Strong written, verbal, presentation and whiteboarding skills, with the ability to communicate complex topics to audiences ranging from network engineers to senior technical and business leaders. Self-motivated and collaborative, able to work independently, prioritise effectively, keep multiple activities moving and perform well in a fast-paced environment. Technical strategies are clear, differentiated and aligned with customer outcomes. Opportunities progress with well-managed technical validation, risk and stakeholder alignment. You expand HPE’s relevance by connecting service provider networking requirements with the broader HPE portfolio and specialist capabilities.
